name: Holy
desc: All cooldowns are reduced by 33%, it even includes the sub-fusion move too. Doesn't effect some moves like Guest Platinum Y.

name: Blessed
desc: Doubles the proc rate of sub effects, also gives a 10% damage buff.

name: Sanctified
desc: Caps all damage taken to 15% of your max health. Damage past this cap grants the user a 14 second damage buff which caps at 2x. it is calculated using this formula: [1+ damagePastcap/200]

name: Divine
desc: Chance to do a random "Critical Hit". [1/3] chance to proc and deals x2 more damage.

name: Saintly
desc: Chance to inflict the Holy Flame. More damage you deal, bigger the chance to proc. Does 25 ticks of burn dmg which deal 2% of the damage that procced it.(Check below for formula)

name: Heavenly
desc: Chance to strike thunder at the target being damaged. Base damage is 8 with a 0.15 second hitstun. Chance multiplier is 3.333 (10/3) (Check below for formula). When you die, you will deal 25 base damage around everyone around you. Heavenly cannot proc subs, however the death effect can.

name: Angelic
desc: Bypasses every "block", "miss" and reflection. Gives a [(0.08/your potency trait multiplier) + 1]x dmg buff to every attack. Most melee types are replaced with angelic melee, barrages get an additional 1.5x damage multiplier and a hit-stun with no knockback. Strong Punches become Angelic Punches which gives 1.1x damage. It will not replace melee types granted by subs.

name: Hallowed
desc: Kills give 25% of your max hp back. Kills now spawn ghosts which grab the nearest opponent and deal 40% of the person you killed's max hp as damage.

name: Righteous
desc: Increases damage up to 1.5x based on the missing health of the target. [y=(x/200)+1] [y = damage multiplier, x = % of hp your opponent lost]. Damage dealt to the user has a 1/6 chance to be nullified and reflected back for half its original damage.

name: Anointed
desc: Outputted damage will always deal slight percentage damage to your opponent. The % damage is 0.175% of your opponent's MAX hp.

name: Transcendent
desc: Buffed defense (1.2x). Transcendent grants resistance to most stuns, slows, grabs and knockback including hitstun.

name: Almighty
desc: Increases defense based on the missing health of the player. Damage reduction scales with endurance. [y=(x/240)+1] [y = defense multiplier, x =amount of hp you lost]

name: Exalted
desc: Reduces damage taken by 33% (1.5x) if the attacker is around 3 meters away. The user gains a 30 stud radius projectile protection shield around themselves that nullifies most projectiles that try to enter it from the outside. This can only happen 10 times before the user needs to wait 15 seconds. The user will only recharge deflects after all deflects are used up. The user can still be attacked if they're spawned inside of this radius. This radius is invisible.
